question:
In the given figure, the length of arc AB is equal to twice the length of radius r of the circle. Find the area of sector OAB in terms of the radius r.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a74d1c192cc60964c1536b9e925b743f90da542216b3b6795c19915280143e3.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the arc AB = 2r 

Where r = radius of the circle 

**Formula Used:**

l = r × θ 

Area of an arc = (θ)/(360) × πr² 

Where l = length of an arc

r = radius of the circle 

**Calculation:**

Here, we have length of the arc = 2r 

⇒ l = r × θ 

⇒ 2r = r × θ 

⇒ θ = 2 

Area of the sector = (θ)/(360) × πr2 

⇒ (2)/(360) × 180 × r² = r² [As π = 180] 

Hence**, the area of the sector OAB in terms of the radius is r².**
